text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш has been extremely
successful in the
G1 races at Tokyo
Racecourse, and an event is
held to
celebrate her numerous
accomplishments.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She talks about her feelings toward
racing. We
commemorate our journey
with a photo together
next to the
monument memorializing all her hard

work.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
